reasoning: On the season so far the Spurs are the stronger team; with home court the Spurs start about 15 points better, in a game of about 226 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Spurs.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Spurs win 92 times in 100, by about 17; most games like this end between 199 and 247 total points.

analyst.text: San Antonio's 12-game winning streak ended against Detroit, and Dylan Harper was helped off holding his groin, with no diagnosis yet. The Clippers were hammered by 25 in Utah, Bradley Beal misses the whole trip, but Brandon Ingram may make his season debut here. The angle still leans clearly towards the Spurs, with Harper's status worth watching.
